decisionsTitle: «Echipa» as a canvas with levels — the president at 1, the counsellor at 1.5 beside her, the team at 2 — no lines, and each card opens in place
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11, 00:20–00:30, after seeing §691's chart on QA:** «I want the team page to be more like this… not with lines, some lines are not clearly defined; can we have more like a canvas? And to be able to select levels, like the president is top level 1, then the advisor level 1.5 and the rest are level 2.» Then: «the advisor is more like a counselor to the president» — the 1.5 card sits beside the level-1 card, smaller, at her side; and «we can click into each person to see more details». The president's drawing: a blue canvas; at the top one wide white card (photo left; name; role title in colour; four lines of responsibilities) with a smaller white card beside it; under them a row of five equal tall white cards (photo, name, role title, one sub-role line, «Responsabilități:» bullets); at the bottom three light boxes. No connector lines.

**Decision (amends §691: the tiers and the connectors are gone, and so are «Răspunde în fața» and «Așezare»).**

- **A level per card drives the layout.** `team_members.level numeric(3, 1)`, nullable, `CHECK team_members_level_range` (`level IS NULL OR (level >= 1 AND level <= 9)`), migration `0139_team_canvas_levels`, expand only; `content/team/fields.ts` accepts whole and half steps alone (`isTeamLevel`, `TEAM_LEVELS`: 1, 1.5, … 9), a comma decimal too, and refuses a quarter step on the box, keeping the rest of the card. The rows are the whole numbers, top first; in a row the `.0` cards are the leads — wide on row 1 while there is one of them, tall otherwise — and the `.5` cards are the small ones beside the leads. Null is "not on the canvas".
- **The layout is pure.** `content/team/domain/canvas.ts#buildCanvasRows` takes the shown cards in the club's order and gives `[{ level, lead, beside }]` ascending; within a group the list's order (`position`); a lone `.5` is a row of small cards with no lead; a card without a level is excluded, and `cardsOffCanvas` names those. `org-chart.ts` is gone with its tests: nothing drew from it.
- **The canvas.** `content/team/ui/TeamCanvas.tsx`: a full-width section in the club's ink blue (`TEAM_CANVAS.canvas = COLOR.blueInk`, 9.9:1 under white — the blue that carries white text at AA; no gradient, the budget of three is spent, §166), to the screen's edges on a phone and inside the gutters with the theme's corners from `sm`; its phone padding and the gap between its rows are the §380 scale's `sectionGap`, and the density guard reads `content/team/ui` now that the page's spacing lives there. Row 1 with a single lead is a wrapping flex row from `md`: the wide card grows from a 480-pixel floor (`WIDE_CARD_MIN_WIDTH`: a 280-pixel photo and a column of words, never less), each small card keeps a 280-pixel column at its right (`SMALL_CARD_WIDTH`), and a small card the row cannot hold wraps under the wide one rather than crushing it or scrolling the page sideways; on a phone they stand in a column. Row 1 with two or more leads — every card at level 2 while the president's is hidden, say — or with none (a lone `.5`) is the grid the rows under use, every lead tall: a second president-sized card beside the first would leave each a few dozen pixels of words. Rows 2 and under are a grid — three to a row from `md`, two from `sm`, one at 320 pixels — with that row's `.5` cards after the `.0` ones, small. The page's boxes (§691) close the canvas as light cards (`TEAM_CANVAS.box = GRADIENT.heroTint`), three across from `md`, one at 320, the rich text as every page draws it. **The same canvas after dark:** the blue is the brand, so `TEAM_CANVAS` (`theme/brand.ts`) is a set of light-scheme tokens the components name instead of the palette — the card colour, ink, muted ink, the club's blue for the role title and the links, the hairline — and `tests/unit/theme/brand.test.ts` holds every pair at AA.
- **Three shapes, one component.** `TeamCanvasCard.tsx` with `variant: "wide" | "tall" | "small"`: wide is photo left and words right (stacked on a phone), tall is photo on top, small is compact with the photo at the left. No label on a small card — the role title the club typed says what the person is. Closed, a card is the photo in its crop (§541), the name, the role title, the sub-role and the first three responsibilities. Each shape's photo says its true width to the browser (§414): a tall card is one, two, three to a row, the albums listing's `cover` column — on a phone the canvas's whole width, never the half a `tile` would claim; the wide card's photo is a new `aside` column of the ladder, 280 pixels from `md`, 240 from `sm`, the whole card below; the small card's a new `thumb` column, 104 from `sm`, 88 below — both measured from the layout, as every column of `media/ladder.ts` is.
- **«Click into a person» is a fold on the card.** «Mai multe» / "More" is a `details`/`summary` on the card itself — server rendered, closed, no script, no route — a 44-pixel target (`DISCLOSURE_SX`) that draws the fold's own arrow and, after it, the person glyph by its registry name (`GLYPHS.person`, §521, §694): the arrow says "this opens", the glyph says what is inside — a chevron there would have been a second arrow that never turns — and the person's name in its accessible name («Mai multe despre …»). Open, it continues the responsibilities from the fourth to the last, then the words about the person and the links (§474), the links in the canvas's own colours. Nothing hidden is in the HTML beyond what the card already published: the fold only folds. A card with nothing beyond its three lines has no fold.
- **The grid stays.** While no shown card has a level the page is the grid it always was, with the boxes under it; with a canvas, the cards without a level are the grid under the canvas, a section's room below it, named «Alți membri ai echipei» / "More of the team" — the canvas keeps «Oamenii echipei», so the two are two lists with two names to a screen reader, never one list twice. The menu, the sitemap, `noindex` and the privacy-notice marker of §459 are unchanged.
- **The editor.** «Nivel» replaces «Răspunde în fața» and «Așezare»: a native select of the scale with «— fără nivel: cardul stă în grilă —» first, the labels in the reader's own decimal mark («1,5» / "1.5"), the posted value the number as written. The Redactor's guide task says it. `reports_to_id` and `placement` stay in the schema (expand only): the save still writes what the fields resolve — null and `below` when nothing is posted — and the public and backoffice reads no longer return them.

**Refused.**

- *Connector lines between the cards.* The owner, of §691's: «some lines are not clearly defined». The rows and the three shapes say who stands where.
- *A free canvas with drag-and-drop.* An island and saved coordinates for a page five people edit from a phone; a level says it in one number, and the layout stays pure and server rendered.
- *A page per person.* A route, a sitemap entry, `noindex` and a privacy-notice line for a fold's worth of words; the fold shows the same words on the same page, closed until pressed.
- *Two wide cards side by side.* The drawing has one president; two leads at level 1 are two tall cards, each whole, rather than two wide ones with no room for words.
- *Dropping §691's columns.* Expand only; the columns are harmless unread.
- *A quarter step.* A third kind of card nobody drew.

**Tests.** Unit, `content/team-canvas.test.ts`: `buildCanvasRows` (rows ascending, `.0` before `.5`, the list's order, a lone `.5`, cards without a level excluded, 2.5 and 3) and «Nivel» (1–9, half steps, comma decimal, null, a quarter step and a word refused on the box, the scale of seventeen). Unit, `content/team-page-render.test.ts`: the grid and the boxes under it with no level; with levels the canvas, its rows by whole number, the three variants in order, the card that has no level in the grid under it with its own name and the canvas's name once, the fold closed with the person's name in its accessible name and the fourth responsibility, the bio and the link inside it, the boxes at the canvas's bottom and nowhere else, no script; a lone 1.5; five leads on the top row all tall in the grid, two leads at level 1 tall with no wrap, and one lead with three small cards wide, wrapping, with the 480-pixel floor and the 280-pixel columns from `md`; each shape's photo `sizes` its own column. Unit, `media/ladder.test.ts`: the `aside` and `thumb` columns. Unit, `theme/brand.test.ts`: the canvas's pairs at AA and its tokens. Unit, `theme/density.test.ts`: the canvas's three spacing sites on the scale and its one allowlisted gutter. Integration on PGlite, `cms/team-org-chart.test.ts`: the save writes the level, the public read returns it per language and no longer the parent, an empty box clears it, a quarter step is refused on the box with nothing written, and the database refuses 10 and 0.5.
changelogLine: - **«Echipa» as a canvas with levels** — the team page is a blue canvas of white cards, no lines: each card gets a «Nivel» (1 the wide card at the top, 1.5 a small card beside it, 2, 3… the tall cards under), «Mai multe» opens a card in place with every responsibility, the bio and the links, the page's boxes close the canvas, and cards without a level stay in the grid. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the team page, when at least one shown card has a level, then the page draws the canvas — this amends criterion 57 (§691): no tiers, no connectors, «Răspunde în fața» and «Așezare» no longer in the editor, `reports_to_id` and `placement` kept in the schema and read by nothing — one row per whole number, top first; row 1's single `.0` card wide, at least 480 pixels from `md`, with each `.5` card of its row a 280-pixel small card beside it and the row wrapping rather than overflowing; a row 1 with two or more `.0` cards, or with none, and every row under it a grid of tall `.0` cards with that row's `.5` cards small after them, all in the club's order; the cards without a level follow in a grid of its own name under the canvas; when no shown card has a level, the page is the grid it always was (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a card's editor, when «Nivel» is saved, then a whole or half step from 1 to 9 is kept and read back, an empty box clears it, and a quarter step or a value off the scale is refused on that box with the rest of the card kept; the database refuses a level outside 1–9 whatever wrote it (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a card on the canvas, when it is drawn, then it shows the photo — its `sizes` the column its shape is drawn in: `cover` tall, `aside` wide, `thumb` small — the name, the role title, the sub-role and at most the first three responsibilities, and — only when there is more — a closed «Mai multe» / "More" fold, server rendered with no script, at least 44 pixels tall, its arrow followed by the person glyph and never a second chevron, named with the person's name, holding the remaining responsibilities, the bio and the links; the page's boxes are drawn once, at the canvas's bottom (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Echipa» as a canvas with levels and folds
